curves.test_conditions: VDS = 10 V, Ta = 25 degC, pulsed, typical 25 degC trace

extraction_notes: Tabulated characteristics are transcribed from p. 2 under Ta = 25 degC; dash entries are represented as null where the schema permits.
Fig. 1 contains six typical pulsed output traces at VGS = 3 V, 4 V, 5 V, 6 V, 8 V, and 10 V. Selected points were digitized from the plotted traces; the figure does not state a temperature.
Fig. 2 contains typical transfer traces versus temperature. The Ta = 25 degC trace was selected and digitized at VDS = 10 V under the figure's pulsed condition.
No capacitance-versus-VDS figure is present. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are tabulated at VDS = 5 V and f = 1 MHz only.
The supplied datasheet does not publish body-diode forward voltage, reverse-recovery time, gate charge, or thermal-resistance values.
extraction.omission_reason: No capacitance-versus-VDS curve, body-diode forward/recovery data, gate-charge data, or thermal-resistance table is published; curve extraction is limited to the typical output and transfer plots.
